settings.heading: 9 inch conversion is what we do best
settings.stat_1_label: bevel and transmission gear experience from

settings.text: The Ford 9 inch is the benchmark for a strong, serviceable rear end. We build complete conversions to suit almost any Australian classic, muscle car, drag car, four wheel drive or live axle car, and IRS on special order.

Years of experience in bevel gear and transmission gear technology from 1992 to 2007, and dedicated 9 inch conversion work ever since. Every conversion is built around your car, your power and how you use it, from a mild street ratio to a full drag setup.

settings.heading: What a conversion includes
settings.text: A complete rear end, set up and ready to bolt in.

settings.title: Housing to suit
settings.text: 9 inch housing built to your track width, spring and brake setup, with the right backing plate register.

settings.title: Centre and ratio
settings.text: Third member assembled with your choice of open, LSD, TrueTrac, mini spool or full spool, and the ratio you want.

settings.title: Axles and bearings
settings.text: Custom axles cut to length and splined, new bearings and seals, studs in the pattern you need.
LJ, LH, LC and UC Torana
Land Cruiser and other four wheel drives
Early Mazda such as RX3, plus live axle and IRS on request
